abstention. For every proposal return evidence_entries: the IDs of all supplied

Do not write quotations, source URLs, offsets or hashes. Go will attach complete
original entries and byte spans, and retain the full supplied context for review.

Copy person, role, organization and name forms exactly from the selected entries.
Do not normalize titles, change word forms, expand names or join text around a
parenthetical nickname. Keep employees and public-board roles as stated, without
promoting them to executives. Keep multiple people, organizations and roles separate.

If name/title blocks lack binding evidence, abstain or mark ambiguous. Adjacency
alone is not proof. An unnamed issuer or organization must remain unresolved.

Use asserted, denied, hypothetical or ambiguous polarity from the full excerpt.
Retractions are not positive assertions. Include entries with relevant denials or
qualifiers. time_text must be exact wording explicitly dating THAT role; otherwise
use an empty string. Page, publication, observation, founding and other-role dates
are not tenure dates. Do not infer time boundaries or precision.

For aliases, copy name_text and alias_text literally from an explicit correspondence.
Preserve the original name form, including parenthetical text when present; do not
construct a canonical name. Each nonempty field must occur as a contiguous string
in at least one selected entry. Valid references do not prove a relationship, a
publisher's truthfulness or the identity of a donor.
